blogs.title: The 5-Day Rule is a Myth: Early Onset HIT After Cardiac Surgery
blogs.description: Analyzes how recent preoperative heparin exposure (e.g., cardiac catheterization) can sensitize patients, triggering HIT thrombocytopenia before the classic postoperative day 5 window, challenging standard diagnostic heuristics.

blogs.title: When the SRA Doesn't Make Sense: Decoding Autoimmune HIT (aHIT)
blogs.description: Deep dive into the serological profile of aHIT, including heparin-independent platelet activation and atypical responses to Fc receptor-blocking antibodies in confirmatory testing that can lead to indeterminate results.

blogs.title: Post-Bypass Platelet Drop: HIT vs. The Usual Suspects
blogs.description: A systematic approach to differentiating HIT from dilutional thrombocytopenia, CPB effects, and other drug-induced causes in the immediate post-cardiac surgery period using clinical context and timing.

blogs.title: Argatroban vs. Fondaparinux: Navigating Anticoagulation in Severe HIT
blogs.description: Compares therapeutic options for HIT, weighing half-life and administration routes, and discusses the specific role of high-dose IVIG in autoimmune variants when standard anticoagulation fails.

blogs.title: Platelets Aren't Enough: Monitoring HIT Treatment with Fibrinogen and D-Dimer
blogs.description: Highlights why platelet count recovery alone is insufficient to rule out ongoing thrombosis, emphasizing trends in fibrinogen, d-dimer, and schistocytosis to assess consumptive coagulopathy.

blogs.title: HIT and the Brain: Recognizing Thrombotic Stroke as a Presentation of HIT
blogs.description: Discusses the high risk of thrombotic complications in HIT, using this case of parietal stroke to illustrate the need for high suspicion of HIT in new neurological deficits with thrombocytopenia.
